card.fires_on: A digit partway through a number in a powers-of-two style list such as 16, 32, 64, or inside a larger figure like 9,600 or 96%. It also fires weakly on a few word parts like beta-blockers.

modes.description: A digit inside a dose amount or percentage.

modes.label: Partway through drug terms
modes.description: A piece inside a drug or class name.
